title: THE LOANER BANDAGES ARE NOT YOUR LOSS
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. Anyone who goes up without a heal is issued two loaner Bandages. They belong to the quartermaster: the extraction card hands them back and does not count them as secured, and the death card already leaves a loaner gun out because you never owned it. But on a death the card listed each loaner Bandage as LOST and added their $120 to the money gone, so a death with $800 of loot read $920 gone. The loaners still carried now come off the death card, from the list, the count and the money.
now: The death card no longer lists the two issued loaner Bandages as lost or counts their money as gone.
